# Thesis

Apple's services growth supports the long-term thesis, while the current
valuation makes a review appropriate if the share price reaches USD 250.

## Supporting points

- Services revenue adds recurring, higher-margin income.
- The installed device base supports continued ecosystem demand.

## Risks
